instruction: Candid photographic full shot from behind of two young women running down an empty city street. On the left, the blonde woman in a black puffer vest and green pants (R2) runs forward while looking back over her shoulder. On the right, the red-haired woman in a light blue knit vest and brown pleated skirt (R1) runs alongside her. They hold hands as they jog away from the camera down the asphalt road. Soft, natural daylight illuminates the scene, casting gentle shadows on the street.
